topics.label: Introduction and lecture objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture within the cancer course and sets out its learning objectives.

topics.label: Mutations and the biological foundations of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations arising in susceptible cells can support clonal evolution toward cancer in a permissive microenvironment.

topics.label: Environmental cancer risks and evidence for their contribution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics weigh the contribution of environmental exposures to cancer against explanations based on chance or inherited predisposition.

topics.label: Infectious agents in cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how infections can drive cancer, with Burkitt lymphoma illustrating the interaction between pathogens and mutation acquisition.

topics.label: How environmental exposures damage DNA
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how environmental carcinogens produce DNA damage and mutations, showing how their effects depend on molecular interactions within exposed cells.

topics.label: Tumour initiation and promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics distinguish mutation-inducing initiation from promotion that enables initiated cells to proliferate in a supportive environment.

topics.label: Carcinogenic mechanisms and tissue susceptibility
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics conclude the mechanistic account by explaining how susceptibility depends on cellular context and recapping the mechanisms that make exposures carcinogenic.

topics.label: Tracing carcinogen exposure through mutational signatures
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how patterns in cancer genomes can provide evidence of exposure to particular carcinogens.

topics.label: Assessing carcinogenicity and the limitations of testing
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how evidence is obtained to assess carcinogenic potential and why that evidence cannot fully reproduce human cancer development.

topics.label: Closing summary and risk–benefit decisions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture by summarising its conclusions and framing exposure decisions as judgements about risks and benefits.
